restaurants.name: Girl & The Goat
restaurants.description: James Beard Award winner Stephanie Izard's flagship restaurant with creative, bold flavors.

restaurants.name: Au Cheval
restaurants.description: Famous for their double cheeseburger - widely considered one of the best in America.

restaurants.name: Portillo's
restaurants.description: Iconic Chicago chain for Italian beef, Chicago-style hot dogs, and chocolate cake.

restaurants.name: Lou Malnati's
restaurants.description: Deep dish pizza institution since 1971. The butter crust is legendary.

restaurants.name: Frontera Grill
restaurants.description: Rick Bayless's celebrated Mexican restaurant featuring regional dishes and incredible moles.

restaurants.name: Alinea
restaurants.description: Three-Michelin-star dining experience. Book months in advance for this culinary journey.

restaurants.name: Pequod's Pizza
restaurants.description: Caramelized cheese crust deep dish that rivals any in the city. Local favorite.

activities.name: Chicago Architecture Boat Tour
activities.description: Cruise the Chicago River while learning about the city's world-famous architecture. Book with Chicago Architecture Center.

activities.name: Art Institute of Chicago
activities.description: World-class art museum featuring iconic works including American Gothic and A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte.

activities.name: Millennium Park & Cloud Gate
activities.description: See 'The Bean,' stroll through Lurie Garden, and enjoy free summer concerts at the Pritzker Pavilion.

activities.name: Navy Pier
activities.description: Iconic pier with a Ferris wheel, restaurants, shops, and lake views. Great for families.

activities.name: Skydeck Chicago (Willis Tower)
activities.description: Step onto The Ledge, a glass floor 1,353 feet above the ground with views of four states.

activities.name: Chicago Riverwalk
activities.description: 1.25-mile pedestrian path along the river with bars, restaurants, and kayak rentals.

activities.name: Second City Comedy Show
activities.description: Legendary improv comedy theater that launched careers of Tina Fey, Steve Carell, and more.

neighborhoods.name: River North
neighborhoods.description: High-energy neighborhood with great dining, galleries, and nightlife.

neighborhoods.name: West Loop
neighborhoods.description: Former meatpacking district turned culinary destination. Home to many celebrity chef restaurants.

neighborhoods.name: Lincoln Park
neighborhoods.description: Family-friendly neighborhood with the free Lincoln Park Zoo and gorgeous tree-lined streets.

neighborhoods.name: Wicker Park/Bucktown
neighborhoods.description: Trendy neighborhood with independent boutiques, great bars, and artistic vibe.

neighborhoods.name: The Loop
neighborhoods.description: Downtown Chicago with iconic architecture, world-class theater, and major attractions.
